semiconductor_relevance: High — Rorze Engineering GmbH specializes in automation solutions and handling systems specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Rorze Engineering GmbH is a leading supplier of automation solutions for semiconductor and flat-panel display industries, providing high-reliability handling robots and equipment.
